messages:
ashley: FYI Sales routed a packaging ask from FinData.
mike_sales: They want a 12mo commit + credits up front + flexible burst for spikes. Current spend ~8k/mo. Asking for hosted parity pricing + 20% credit.
jordan_fin: Flag: we can do blended, but need floors. We can't let credits drive ARR below commit. Need min guaranteed throughput.
eva_support: They had two P1s last quarter. They'll ask for SLA + on-call. That makes Dedicated or Dedicated-like offering sensible.
ashley: Draft idea: "Commit + Burst Pool" playbook. Commit = fixed monthly token allotment. Burst pool = shared buffer billed at a higher multiplier. One-time onboarding credit instead of recurring credits.
mike_sales: Sales needs a quick checklist for negotiations: allowed credit %, min commit, burst multiplier, sign-off matrix.
jordan_fin: Proposed numeric guardrails: min commit = $6k/mo OR 100M tokens; onboarding credit <= 2 months at committed rate; burst multiplier = 2.5x; first-two-months overage forgiveness only if commit >= min and RevOps approved.
billing-bot: Note: any deviation reducing projected ARR >15% requires RevOps + Finance sign-off. Workflow: PATCH_BILLING_WORKFLOW_2 https://ok.redwood/revops/workflows/patch2
ashley: Anna (PM) can we make this a documented option in the pricing playbook? If so, sales uses a template and triage time drops.
anna_pm: Yes — will own playbook doc. Need clear launch criteria: doc + approval matrix + SLA templates + reporting hooks in Console.
legal-bot: SLA templates available but require customer-specific redlines for financial penalties. Legal review needed for any SLA with credits/forgiveness.
eva_support: Also add an escalation ladder and what triggers Dedicated migration. Include runbook links and support-contact requirements.
mike_sales: I'll collect typical asks from AE pool and draft negotiation email snippets.
ashley: Action items: I'll author initial playbook PR. @jordan_fin finalize numeric guardrails. @eva_support add SLA & runbooks. @mike_sales collect AE asks and examples. Will ping Legal for SLA review. Target: draft by EOD Thu and link here. :thumbsup:
